name: Encora
description:
Fetches theatrical performance metadata from https://encora.it
You must provide your own API key

versions.changelog:
## What's Changed
* Updated readme by @KristAude in https://github.com/pekempy/Jellyfin.Plugin.Encora/pull/1
* Update README.md by @KristAude in https://github.com/pekempy/Jellyfin.Plugin.Encora/pull/2
* Refactored to remove NFOMetadataProvider separately and incorporate the logic into the Encora Provider.
* Change thumb generation to be a random time during the video (15-60% of duration) to handle shorter highlight videos

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/pekempy/Jellyfin.Plugin.Encora/compare/1.0.0.0...1.0.0.1

### Initial Release
The first release of the Encora agent for Jellyfin!

#### Features:
- Fetch from Encora based on the ID
- Fetch headshots 
- Download subtitles (may need a second 'refresh' for new files after downloading)
- Customise the names of your library
- Fetch posters from stagemedia
